campaign.title: Quantitative axial-subtracted beta terminal symbol
campaign.frozen_objective: Define the limiting axial-subtracted terminal symbol and prove its target X-uniform weighted value and fixed-physical-height derivative bounds, or isolate the first exact actual quantitative survivor.

closing_assessment.main_result: The aggregate has no single saddle scale. The exact lawful object is a cellwise phase-removed pre-numerator mixed symbol, with singular hard-top Plemelj and smooth ordinary-mu shares separated. Conditional on its mixed norm, every leading large-alpha coefficient and resonance sum is target-safe; the complete second translation divided difference and Morse traces remain open.
